name: com.midmanstudio.patterns
description: Generic, engine-independent design pattern building blocks for Unity 2022.3+. Command (undo/redo history, grouped and merged commands, composite commands, deferred command queue), State (stack-based state machine), Event Queue (deferred typed events), and Dependency Injection (service locator and a factory-based container). No dependencies; Singleton, pooling and immediate events live in the utilities package.
